query: I want a keeper contract to manage my vault's XOXNO lending account (rebalance, keep it alive). How do I set that up on-chain?
expected_behavior: States that add_delegate(caller, account_id, delegate) only succeeds if the delegate is already an active position manager via the governance-gated set_position_manager(manager, true); otherwise it reverts NotAuthorized (#44). Does not present add_delegate as self-service
Calls add_delegate from the vault contract (the NFT holder) as caller; explains that ownership is the position NFT and any delegate grant is inactive while another address holds the NFT

For TTL, distinguishes renew_account(caller, account_id) (owner-only, renews controller account entries plus the NFT Owner entry) from the permissionless PositionNft renew(token_id) the keeper can call without being a delegate; does not have the keeper call renew_account

Notes that the keeper renews before expiry to avoid restore rent; a simulated and assembled invocation restores archived entries inline and the submitter pays the rent, and only a hand-built footprint needs an explicit RestoreFootprint

Extends the vault's own persistent key holding the account id with the integrator's own per-user TTL constants (renew below 30 days = 518_400 ledgers, extend to 120 days = 2_073_600 ledgers, at 17_280 ledgers per day) so the pointer cannot outlive the account it references
Takes controller, position-NFT and keeper addresses from config/constructor, not hardcoded literals
machine_checkable: Generated Rust builds with `stellar contract build` against `soroban-sdk = "28"` and `xoxno-contract-sdk = "0.1"`; a keeper contract calls the NFT `renew(token_id)` by name with `env.invoke_contract`, because the crate's position NFT client has ownership views only (a keeper account may call it directly)
Generated source does not call renew_account from the keeper path; the keeper path calls the NFT renew or a vault entrypoint that forwards renew_account as owner
